title: Career Café — 1:1 Prep with Calvin Cho
body:
Purpose: quick, high-energy 1:1 framed as a 'Career Café' — combine status check + coaching + micro-commitments. Keep to ~25–30 min.

Meeting logistics
- When: 2027-07-19 10:30am (30 min)
- Location: Zoom / personal room (calvin-zoom)
- Prep ask to Calvin (sent yesterday): bring 2 wins, 1 blocker, and 1 idea they'd like feedback on.

Start script (1–2 min)
- Quick mood check: "On a 1–10 how's the week going? Any immediate fires?"
- Frame: "I want this to be useful for career moves and unblockers; we'll leave with 2 clear next steps."

Agenda (approx):
1) 2-min recap: wins / highlights (let Calvin lead)
2) Signal check (3–4 min): metrics / ops / stack health briefly
3) Deep dive (10–12 min): career / scope / project coaching (Calvin's choice)
4) Blockers & support (6–8 min): concrete asks, resources, decisions
5) Wrap & action items (2–3 min)

Signal / data to glance at before meeting (do not deep-dive unless asked):
- Median inference latency (last 24h) for team model: ~48ms (spike yesterday to 320ms for short window) — likely due to autoscaler thrash.
- Error rate: 0.7% (slightly above goal 0.5%) — incidents labeled INF-4821.
- Recent PRs: #897 (kv-cache fix) merged, #904 (quantization perf) awaiting review.
- Load: 12k requests/min at peak region-us-west1.

Quick context on Calvin (notes to self):
- Senior SWE (level 4), joined 10 months ago from systems team.
- Strong on low-level perf/optimizations; wants to grow into tech lead/manager later but uncertain on next steps.
- Nervous about public speaking; avoided cross-team demos so far.
- Recently took ownership of autoscale policy prototype (INF-4976).

Deep dive prompts (pick 1–2, use open questions):
- "What's one decision you made recently that you'd make differently now? Why?"
- "If you had a stretch assignment for 6 weeks that would help your growth, what would it be? What would success look like?"
- "Who on the team do you want to mentor/partner with this quarter? What's the first step?"
- Coaching micro-skills: ask for examples, reflect, suggest one experiment, agree a short runway.

Blockers (from async updates):
- Waiting on capacity numbers from infra for autoscale rollout (ticket INF-4976) — blocker for canary next week.
- Needs final sign-off on quantization perf tradeoffs (PR #904) — ask: can I unblock with a short review or escalate to Marco?
- Personal: family travel next week (affects availability) — confirm calendar coverage.

Concrete asks to make in the meeting (decisions to propose):
- Proposal A: ship autoscaler canary to 10% traffic on Tue if infra provides buffer by Mon EOD. Ask Calvin if he can own the canary monitor config.
- Proposal B: split PR #904 into two smaller PRs (perf-critical vs telemetry) to unblock merge. Ask if he prefers to split or get a hand to review.

Career coaching & growth plan (5–10 min)
- Short-term goal (next 3 months): lead one cross-team demo + publish postmortem-style notes on the autoscaler rollout.
- Mid-term goal (6–12 months): stretch into tech lead role — run planning for a small feature area and mentor an IC.
- Suggested micro-experiments (pick 1):
  * Volunteer to present a 15-min "autoscale lessons learned" at next team sync.
  * Pair with Priya on the rollout checklist and co-author the canary playbook.
  * Small people-growth: take an intern/returnee buddy for 4 weeks (sprints).
- We should define 1 measurable signal for success: "deliver demo + mentor evidence (1 mentee feedback)" within 12 weeks.

Follow-ups from last 1:1 (status):
- Action: reach out to infra for capacity numbers -> pending (Calvin said he messaged Sam on Slack; no reply).
- Action: draft canary monitor runbook -> draft exists, needs my review.
- Action: join Q2 OKR review -> done (Calvin submitted notes).

My prep notes (things I will say / reminders):
- Praise specific: "The autoscaler prototype reduced 95th percentile latency on test bench by 22% — that was a big technical win."
- Calibrate expectations on leadership: "Leading a demo doesn't mean you must know every detail; it's about clear communication and surface-level ownership."
- Offer: I can block 30–60 minutes this week for a focused PR pairing session.

Action items (to capture at end of meeting)
- Calvin: confirm whether he will own canary monitor config and be on-call for Tuesday canary (due: 2027-07-20).
- Ethan (me): review canary runbook and PR #904 comments by EOD Mon (2027-07-19).
- Calvin: draft 1-page outline for cross-team demo (due: 2027-07-29).
- Ethan + Priya: schedule 45m pairing on PR split strategy if Calvin wants help (tentative: 2027-07-21).

How to close the meeting (1 min):
- Quick recap of 2 commitments and confirm calendar blockers.
- End with appreciation and invite a simple ask: "Anything I can take off your plate this week?"

Post-meeting notes template (I will paste here after meeting):
- Date/time: 
- Mood check: 
- 2 wins: 
- 1 blocker: 
- Key decisions we made: 
- Action items assigned + due dates: 
- Notes to myself (coaching tips / follow-ups): 

Random scratch (for my memory):
- Possible follow-up: pair Calvin with someone from product for demo narrative framing.
- Long-term: consider stretch program cohort for 4 engineers wanting to level to lead.

Unresolved questions to chase after meeting:
- Who is the infra owner for capacity numbers? (is it Sam or Lena?) Confirm and cc me.
- Do we need a short risk rollback plan for the canary? If yes, who owns rollback?

-- end of prep --

(rough drafts: short sentences, TODOs, and shorthand are intentional — will tidy into meeting notes when done)
summary: Manager scratchpad for a 30-minute 1:1 (Career Café style) with Calvin. Includes agenda, signals to glance at, coaching prompts, blockers, concrete decisions to propose, career experiments, and explicit action items.
